title: HELIOS upstream watch list (config/fork-watch.json)
description: Read by .github/workflows/fork-observation.yml (weekly, read-only digest). Mirrors that workflow's own preflight - `repos` non-empty, owner/name slugs, a non-blank `because`, signals drawn from the set it can fetch - so a bad entry fails here before it fails on the schedule. signals is required here (the workflow tolerates its absence but then has nothing to report for the repo).

repos.description: fork-observation.yml walks this list serially, making two authenticated requests per entry with `curl --max-time 30`, so the list length is the workflow's running time. 50 is far above the shipped digest and far below a list that would hold a runner for hours.

repo.description: owner/name slug of a public GitHub repository.

because.description: Why it is watched and which HELIOS piece the signal feeds; printed in the digest.
